title: John Peterson's 1998 Arlington Institute meeting on extraterrestrials living among us
summary: Richard Dolan tells of John Peterson's 1998 Arlington Institute meeting on extraterrestrials living among us, about 1998 at Arlington Institute, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we're doing a little get together uh of a mini conference to discuss what it's what it would be like in a world where extraterrestrials are openly acknowledged as living among us.

plain: A UFO historian, Richard Dolan, relays what Catherine Austin Fitts told him about a 1998 meeting held by John Peterson at a group called the Arlington Institute. According to the invitation as Dolan tells it, it was a small mini conference to discuss what the world would be like if extraterrestrials were openly acknowledged as living among us. If true, it would suggest some people were quietly preparing for such an announcement.
